item.vehiclecore.bomb_bay.description: Thèid TNT, chan eil e a’ briseadh bùthan ach bidh e a’ dèanamh milleadh mòr.
item.vehiclecore.heavy_crossbow.descript: Crosbò trom le punch làidir, feumaidh e freagairtean.
item.vehiclecore.airship.description: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.vehiclecore.cargo_airship.descripti: Slow agus ag ithe fuel ach a’ tairgse stòradh iomlan.
item.vehiclecore.debug.description: Luath agus gu math earbsach. Dèan cinnteach gu bheil do rìoghachd fada gu leòr.
item.vehiclecore.gyrodyne.description: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.vehiclecore.quadrocopter.descriptio: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.vehiclecore.bamboo_hopper.descripti: Aircraft chonky le tri suidheachan agus pontoons airson tilleadh gu sàbhailte air uisge.
vehiclecore.gyrodyne_target_reached: Toraidhean iarann air rotair as ìsle, deiseil airson tocail!
vehiclecore.invalid_dimension: Chan eil an aircraft seo ag obair anns an raon seo.
vehiclecore.fat.out: Tha thu ro ghrànda airson a bhith a’ tighinn!
option.vehiclecore.separateCamera: Usaibh camara air leth ann an aer-líon.
option.vehiclecore.useThirdPersonByDefau: Default gu camara ann an treas duine ann an aer-líon.
option.vehiclecore.burnFuelInCreative: Losgadh gas ann an mod cruthachail.
option.vehiclecore.useCustomKeybindSyste: Usaibh iuchra-làimhe ioma, dh’fhaodadh e ceartachadh modan sònraichte.
option.vehiclecore.showHotbarEngineGauge: Freagair an gheòidh inneal thairis air a’ hotbar.
option.vehiclecore.crashDamage: Dàmhnaich an saoghal nuair a thuiteas.
option.vehiclecore.preventKillThroughCra: Cha phlabhairt e an saoghal nuair a thuiteas.
option.vehiclecore.healthBarRow: Cuir air falbh an slighe slàinte de chàraichean.
option.vehiclecore.damagePerHealthPoint: Lorg a bharrachd freagairtean a’ dèanamh na h- aircraft nas seasmhachd.
option.vehiclecore.weaponsAreDestructive: Goirid cuid armachd a thoirt air a’ bhloigh.
option.vehiclecore.dropInventory: Thoir às an innleachd, na shàbhail e taobh a-staigh an t-adhair.
option.vehiclecore.dropUpgrades: Thoir às na leasachadh agus freagairtean, na shàbhail e taobh a-staigh an t-adhair.
option.vehiclecore.regenerateHealthEvery: Ath-nuair a’ cur slàinte gach tick a thèid seachad, a’ simileadh giùlan vanilla.
option.vehiclecore.requireShiftForRepair: Fulang ri gèir fhad ’s a tha thu a’ cumail shift, mura h-eil, faodaidh tu dìreach a dhol a-steach don chàraichean.
vehiclecore.tooltip.no_target: Feumaidh e a bhith air a chuir seachad air an làr!
